classification: Structural comparison only; not a semantic replay.

old.guardMeaning: Each W control proves that a failed durable write exits nonzero and emits no success marker; it has no finalization receipt and therefore no applicable pin-coverage verdict.
old.shapeW: the durable result path is a directory, so the durable write fails; the run exits nonzero with no success marker

new.guardMeaning: Each W control requires a nonzero exit, an absent durable receipt, and its declared case-specific diagnostics; only LV-W also declares stdoutAbsent. No W control has a finalization receipt, so pin coverage is not applicable.
new.shapeW: the durable result path is a directory, so the durable write fails; each case exits nonzero with no durable result and its declared stderr; LV-W additionally requires no PASS.json and no LIFE1-VALIDATOR PASS stdout marker
